headline: Trump Administration Modifies Tariffs on Canadian Goods
summary: The Trump administration announced adjustments to Canadian trade measures taking effect October 30, lifting tariffs on agricultural equipment while imposing new import duties on other select products.
why: Trade policy shifts between the US and Canada directly impact bilateral supply chains in manufacturing, agriculture, and cross-border trade flows.

impacts.name: Agricultural Machinery
impacts.why: Removing import levies on Canadian farm machinery lowers equipment costs for North American farmers.
